reasons: Same result definition: lignin yield on dry biomass.
Same material identity and measurement method.
Only one run per condition: the difference cannot be separated from run-to-run noise.

interpretation.observed: The run that combined hotplate and ball milling recovered more lignin (2.30 % vs 0.96 % of dry biomass).
possible_explanations: Heating first may dissolve lignin before mechanical treatment, exposing fresh surface.
Ball milling over the whole period may simply reduce contact time with the liquid phase.
alternative_explanations: Run-to-run variation: no replicates were recorded.
Different local temperature at the sample, even at the same set point.
interpretation.limits: Two single runs; no replicate statistics; causal attribution is not possible.
